Eloise (CSM): Silverpine dedicated bring-up set for Tue 08:00 PT. They want steady 600 RPS, short business spikes to 2k for 20-40s. Need final quota check, autoscale tuning, and a short handoff doc for their on-call. Renewal flagged in 11 months so we want a clean execution.

Rahul (SRE): Got it. Contracted reserved_gpus=10, burst_policy=allow+15% when spare. I'll add a 12h post-cutover slot lock and soft-throttle at 78% GPU mem. Share token dist pls.

Eloise (CSM): Quick sample: p50=58, p95=195, avg request ~280 tokens. Uploading CSV to the customer workspace.

Gustav (Infra): With p95 ~195, pick slot_max_seq=512. Autoscale suggestion: min_slots=3, target_gpu_util=70%, scale_step=1, cooldown=100s. Fallback to quantized-eco if tail latency >550ms over 2m. Also avoid KMS rotate window on the run day.

Nia (Solutions): Load plan: 1) smoke 10m @100RPS 2) soak 90m @600RPS 3) spike script: 20s ramp -> 2k, hold 30s, decay 40s. Will collect token latency and trace ids. I'll post the exact loadgen command later.

Rahul (SRE): Can we pre-warm KV cache? Recommend priming 30m before with mixed prefixes to reach ~40k cached tokens per slot. Also add alert: >3 throttles in 1h => paging.

Gustav (Infra): I'll run priming job tonight EOD. Example snippet I used: `python prime.py --endpoint /prime --slots 6 --concurrency 30 --duration 1800`

Eloise (CSM): Action items: @Gustav priming & autoscale apply (EOD), @Rahul soft-throttle & slot lock (AM), @Nia run load scripts. I'll host the 08:00 PT call and include billing + renewals. ops-bot set reminder.

ops-bot: reminder: "Silverpine dedicated warmup" scheduled for 2024-05-07T15:00:00Z (Tue 08:00 PT). Post-run summary will be auto-attached here. :bell:

Nia (Solutions): Noted. I'll also add a quick troubleshooting section for they SREs: what to look at in the console if latency climbs (cache hit, batch size, model fallback).

Eloise (CSM): Great — keep replies short. If quota mismatch, page me immediately. We'll record feedback in the onboarding retrospective and update renewal health. :thumbsup:
